findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/planner-unattended-smoke.ts:402 WHY: the smoke that is cited as coverage for planner/worktree linkage does not currently run to completion on this branch. Repro: npm --prefix packages/main run test:planner-unattended-smoke exits 1 with a runtime import failure between packages/main/src/core/store.ts:14 and packages/main/src/core/phase-flow.ts, so CHK-003/004 do not have a passing regression proof right now. severity=medium. Fix: repair the runtime export/import mismatch (or replace this smoke evidence with a passing targeted test) before relying on planner-unattended-smoke as verification evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved after reproducing the failure mode and rerunning serially after build. The import/export is present in source and dist after npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:planner-unattended-smoke passed when not raced against dist rebuild. Current validation also passes 15/15 coverage.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/lattice-authority-native.ts:164 WHY: receipt verification now treats any non-lowercase "ed25519" value as unsupported, and packages/main/src/tasks/authority-client-smoke.ts:1158 hardens that behavior. This breaks the Ed25519 happy path for casing-only server variants (for example "ED25519") instead of only failing closed on truly unsupported algorithms. severity=high. Fix: lowercase-normalize serverKey.algorithm before comparison and keep the smoke focused on genuinely unsupported algorithms like rsa.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit de8113c7 and verified after commit ac102936. serverKey.algorithm is now trim/lowercase-normalized before comparing to ed25519; canonical ed25519 and ED25519 casing variant verify, while blank, rsa, and non-string algorithm material fail closed as unsupported. Commands passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm run test:authority-client; node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-e3d9.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/authority-client.ts:1833 WHY: CHK-001 is only fail-closed on the policy-discovery fallback path. When a production deployment pins LATTICE_AUTHORITY_SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY / authority.md key material, resolveGateVerifyConfig skips discoverPolicy entirely, so serverKey.algorithm is never loaded into AuthorityGateVerifyConfig and verifyLatticeAuthorityReceipt never sees the unsupported-algorithm guard required by docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-authority-receipt-contract.md:174-181. I reproduced this on the current HEAD with a fake authority server that would publish serverKey.algorithm="rsa" while the local env pins the same Ed25519 public key: resolveAuthorityGateEvaluator returned counts.policy=0 plus decisionStatus=verified / receiptVerified=true, so the gate accepted a receipt even though the declared algorithm was unsupported. packages/main/src/tasks/authority-client-smoke.ts:1118-1235 only covers the discovery path (explicitly unsetting SERVER_KEY_ID / pinned key material), so this regression stays untested. severity=high. Fix: make production receipt verification resolve and enforce serverKey.algorithm even when the public key is pinned locally (for example still discover policy for algorithm/keyId, or require pinned algorithm metadata and fail closed when it is absent), and add a smoke that exercises the pinned-key path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by commit 309a856c. resolveGateVerifyConfig and resolveServerVerifyMaterial now consult policy serverKey metadata even when env/authority.md pins the server public key, while keeping the pinned key as the trust anchor and never allowing policy publicKeyHex to override it. authority-client smoke covers pinned key plus policy algorithm=rsa fail-closed for gate evaluation and job status, and pinned key plus ED25519 accepted. Verified with build, authority-client smoke, gap_analyze 0 high/0 medium, planner/worktree/dry-run/gap hygiene smokes, and validate 15/15.
